124:t_032:10.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

124:t_033:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Did we get him...?!」

124:t_034:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's ridiculous... This is merely the most basic use of $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

124:t_035:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear...! This won't do!」

124:t_035:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, get clear! The poison is coming!」

124:t_035:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're too slow at everything.」

124:t_036:1.en:
$n
「Are these the nanomachines that hit us...?!」

124:t_036:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This time, they're a type that contaminates a wider area. Everyone on this battlefield will be exposed.」

124:t_037:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You don't even distinguish between friend and foe?!」

124:t_037:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ can't cover an area this large...!」

124:t_037:3.en:
$$カツ$$
「Wait, please! We can still fight!」

124:t_037:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If we hang on a little longer, I'm sure...!」

124:t_037:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Retreat. If we misjudge when to withdraw, we'll suffer losses we can't undo.」

124:t_037:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Cool your heads! The war doesn't end here!」

124:t_037:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, hurry and disengage! I'll give you the rendezvous point shortly!」

124:t_037:10.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

124:t_038:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...What will you do, Lord $$バルビエル$$?」

124:t_038:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The answer is obvious. I'll leave the rest to you, $$サルディアス$$.」

124:t_038:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then I'll send in the pursuit forces as arranged.」

124:t_038:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What fools they are. They should have kept playing their little games at $$ターミナル・ベース$$...」

124:t_038:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Learn just how far beneath us you are, Earthlings.」

124:t_039:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Four minutes have elapsed since the operation began! $$ティエリア$$'s machine has not reached the target point!」

124:t_039:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then the operation has failed...! We have no choice but to retreat!」

124:t_039:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I... couldn't live up to everyone's expectations...!」

124:t_040:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-What have I done...?! A failure here deserves ten thousand deaths...!」

124:t_040:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll withdraw...! I must endure the unendurable, bear the unbearable, and wait for a chance to avenge this humiliation!」

124:t_041:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「A man who talks far more than he needs to is an ugly sight.」

124:t_041:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But guys like that don't give up easily. He's bound to show up in front of us again.」

124:t_100:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s will, sleeping within $$ヴェーダ$$... Something inside me is sounding an alarm...)

124:t_100:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Was $$イオリア$$'s plan truly complete with the emergence of $$イノベイター$$s...?)

124:t_100:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(To find that out, I must take $$ヴェーダ$$ back with my own hands...!)

124:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Just watch, you bastard $$サルディアス$$...! I'll make up for my mistake here, and someday I'll take your position...!)

124:t_101:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
($c...! To do that, I'll use you as my stepping-stone!)

124:t_102:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh...! You're the famed Captain $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

124:t_102:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you know who I am?」

124:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course I do...! You bear a far more important role than you yourself imagine.」

124:t_102:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Neither I nor Earth has time to indulge that nonsense...!」

124:t_102:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm simply fighting as one soldier to liberate Earth!」

124:t_103:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh ho... You're quite skilled. Even on a galactic scale, pilots with skills like yours are rare.」

124:t_103:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is this guy... toying with me...?!」

124:t_103:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I haven't the slightest room to toy with a first-rate opponent like you.」

124:t_103:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If I seem relaxed, that's probably the wisdom of age.」

124:t_103:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's dangerous to let him set the pace...! This man isn't just a glib fool!」

124:t_103:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... Thank you for thinking so highly of me.」

124:t_104:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Another unusual machine has appeared...! This planet is like a jack-in-the-box!」

124:t_104:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is he talking about the $$ユニコーン$$...?!」

124:t_104:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You seem unaware, as I thought. You should learn a little more about how exceptional you are.」

124:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And while you're at it, please hurry up and admit that resisting is futile.」

124:t_104:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't fall for those words! As long as there's even a chance left, I'll fight with everything I've got!」

124:t_105:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I see... Meeting someone like you makes $$サイデリアル$$'s reasons for invading rather understandable.」

124:t_105:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, no, no... I'm just a lowly middle manager in the field, too. I don't know the truth.」

124:t_105:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But I will say this. An existence like yours is both hope and despair.」

124:t_106:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh ho... So you're the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$ I've heard about.」

124:t_106:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, you see... I may not look it, but I've had quite a few connections with $$リアクター$$s...」

124:t_106:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The galaxy is vast, but I may be the only person who's actually met this many $$リアクター$$s.」

124:t_106:4.en:
$n
「Unfortunately for you, that record ends here.」

124:t_106:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, that's frightening. Fearless youth is a frightening thing indeed.」

124:t_106:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you don't seem able to use your $$スフィア$$ properly at all yet. That's a relief, at least.」

124:t_106:7.en:
$n
「What do you know about my $$スフィア$$?! I'll shut that busy mouth of yours!」

124:t_107:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「I understand, $$ゼロ$$. $$藤堂$$ and the others are fighting hard in $$新日本$$...」

124:t_107:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「For the people of $$新日本$$ too, we must strike at the heart of the $$新地球皇国$$ as soon as possible...!」

124:t_107:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have nothing left to say.」

124:t_107:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But don't forget. We cannot allow ourselves to fall before the day we fulfill that wish...!」

124:t_107:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We are $$ゼロ$$! We'll answer the people's wishes and bring about a miracle!」

124:t_108:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't forgive you...! I'll never forgive you, $$サイデリアル$$!」

124:t_108:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Calm down, $$カレン$$. These aren't enemies you can defeat if you lose your cool.」
